subject: general
question: _______ is a device by which two different photographs of the same object can be viewed together.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stereoscope.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stereoscope**

 
 
• A stereoscope is a device by which two different photographs of the same object can be viewed together.
 
• It is a device for viewing left-eye and right-eye views of the same scene, as a single three-dimensional image.
 
• The main advantage of stereoscopic vision is that it provides a **three-dimensional image** of the world.
 
• Each eye sees a slightly different image, and the brain combines these two images to create a three-dimensional image.
 
• There are different types of stereoscopes:
 
 
• **Wheatstone stereoscope**
 
• **Brewster stereoscope**
 
• **Holmes stereoscope**
 
• **Multiple view stereoscope**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stroboscope**

 
 
• The stroboscope is used for visual analysis of objects in periodic motion and for high-speed photography.
 
• ​The principle is used for the study of rotating, reciprocating, oscillating or vibrating objects.
 
• **Machine parts** and **vibrating strings** are common examples. 
 
• Using stroboscope speeds can be measured for objects that are visible but not easily accessible.
 
 
 
• **Stethoscope**
 
 
• Stethoscope is a medical instrument used in listening to sounds produced in the heart or lungs. 
 
• The word stethoscope comes from the Greek words stethos, meaning chest, and skopein, meaning to explore. 
 
• There are three general types of stethoscopes available to consumers:
 
 
• **traditional acoustic**
 
• **amplifying**
 
• **digitizing**
 
 
 
 
 
• **Spectroscope**
 
 
• A spectroscope is defined as an instrument that measures the chemical make-up or spectrum of light of an object. 
 
• Spectroscopes also work to help scientists determine the chemical composition of atoms. 
 
• Early astronomers used spectroscopes to study the composition of planets and stars.
